notes: SPIN / madewithspin.com (Shopify). Access: direct HTTP (curl_cffi) for collections.json/products.json/sitemap, Playwright/CDP to resolve the one genuinely ambiguous 'Collection' page per brief Sec. on 'COLLECTION PAGES NEED INSPECTION'. Discovery: checked mobile-nav drawer (top item 'New' -> /collections/new), desktop header, footer, collections.json (236 collections total, single page), and the collections sitemap. 'New' (/collections/new) was opened and inspected per the brief's mandatory Collection-page test: plain HTTP shows zero rendered /products/ links and no h1/count banner; Playwright with full scroll and JS execution still shows no dedicated product grid - the page instead renders byte-for-byte the SAME sections as the site's own homepage (identical 'Curated Sets' carousel, identical category 'See All (N)' tiles for Living/Dining/Accessories/Outdoor/Home Office/Bar, identical header filter-pills, identical footer). This is a marketing/landing reuse of the index template with no listing representing 'recently added products' - EXCLUDED per brief Sec. 3 (not an ambiguous case, since it unambiguously has no product grid of its own; not flagged MANUAL REVIEW). Found via collections.json + sitemap (not linked in current nav): 'New Addition' (/collections/new-addition) - a genuine, actively-updated (updated_at 2026-09-08) flat PLP with the theme's standard count banner - and 'New Chairs' (/collections/new-chairs, published 2025-09-16, updated 2026-09-01) - also a genuine flat PLP with its own count banner. Checked overlap: New Addition and New Chairs share only 7 of 16 products (not a subset either way), so New Chairs is an independently-curated 'newest chairs' listing rather than a formal child of New Addition - both recorded as flat sibling rows under New Arrivals, no is_group used (no breadcrumb/page groups them together). collections.json's own products_count is inflated vs an exhaustive /products.json?limit=250 enumeration for both (New Addition: 208 reported vs 198 exhaustive, matching the on-page banner; New Chairs: 16 reported = 16 exhaustive, no inflation) - exhaustive counts used throughout. No 'just-in'/'latest-arrivals'/'whats-new'-style handles exist elsewhere on the store.
